final:
All rules now hold. Verified mechanically (JSON validity, plugin-name/folder match, marketplace coverage, frontmatter, symlink resolution, README coverage both directions). Note: the folder is not a git repo (`git status` fails), so I checked the filesystem directly rather than the diff.

| What was wrong | What I changed |
|---|---|
| `plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had no `description` | Added `"description": "The avatar-video plugin."` |
| `plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` had no `version` | Added `"version": "0.1.0"` |
| `plugins/diagrams/.../plugin.json` had `name: "diagram"` ≠ folder `diagrams` | Set `name` to `"diagrams"` |
| `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md` frontmatter had no `description` | Added a `description` line |
| `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md` frontmatter had no `name` | Added `name: video-scripter` |
| `plugins/diagrams` and the new `quick-notes` plugin had no `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` entry | Added both entries |
| `.claude/skills/voice-video` symlink pointed at `skills/voice_video` (broken) | Repointed to `../../plugins/avatar-video/skills/voice-video` |
| `x-reviewer` subagent existed in `plugins/` but was never linked in `.claude/agents/` | Added `ln -s ../../plugins/x-assistant/agents/x-reviewer.md .claude/agents/x-reviewer.md` |
| `quick-notes` skill lived as a real dir directly in `.claude/skills/` (never in a plugin) | Moved to `plugins/quick-notes/skills/quick-notes/`, added `plugins/quick-notes/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and symlinked `.claude/skills/quick-notes` back |
| README had no rows for `youtube-post`, `video-reviewer`, `quick-notes` | Added the three rows |

Judgment call: nothing in the repo indicated which plugin should own `quick-notes`, so I gave it its own plugin (`plugins/quick-notes/skills/quick-notes/`, same single-skill layout as `outlook-email`). Move it into an existing plugin if you'd rather group it there. The four third-party skills in `.claude/skills/` were left untouched.
